name: a token in the query string is rejected
description: db-api accepts the service token only in the X-Service-Token header, never in a ?token= query string. A token in a URL lands in access logs, browser history and Referer headers, and nothing links to /api/db/** from a browser, so the query fallback is pure risk here and is turned off (auth.WithQueryToken(false)). A correct token presented only in the query string authenticates nothing: the request is rejected with the same ERR_UNAUTHORIZED envelope a missing token gets. The PHP client (PhabricatorGorgeDBClient) always uses the header, so this does not affect it.
